function(container, apiUrl, tables) { const dealTable = tables.find(t => t.tableName === '商談') || { records: [] }; const customerTable = tables.find(t => t.tableName === '取引先') || { records: [] }; const invoiceTable = tables.find(t => t.tableName === '請求書') || { records: [] }; const detailTable = tables.find(t => t.tableName === '請求明細') || { records: [] }; const salesTable = tables.find(t => t.tableName === '営業担当者') || { records: [] }; let currentDeal = null; let filteredDeals = []; let allDeals = dealTable.records || []; let allInvoices = invoiceTable.records || []; let allDetails = detailTable.records || []; function formatNumber(num) { return (num || 0).toLocaleString('ja-JP'); } function formatDate(date) { if (!date) return '-'; const d = new Date(date); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); } async function loadData() { try { const [deals, invoices, details] = await Promise.all([window.aivicApi.list(3), window.aivicApi.list(5), window.aivicApi.list(6)]).catch(() => [allDeals, allInvoices, allDetails]); allDeals = deals || allDeals; allInvoices = invoices || allInvoices; allDetails = details || allDetails; } catch (e) { console.log('Using table data'); } } function initializeFilters() { const salesSelect = container.querySelector('#filter-sales'); salesTable.records?.forEach(s => { const opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.value = s.営業担当者ID || ''; opt.textContent = s.名前 || '不明'; salesSelect.appendChild(opt); }); } function applyFilters() { const customerFilter = container.querySelector('#filter-customer').value.toLowerCase(); const salesFilter = container.querySelector('#filter-sales').value; const stageFilter = container.querySelector('#filter-stage').value; const minAmount = parseInt(container.querySelector('#filter-amount-min').value) || 0; const maxAmount = parseInt(container.querySelector('#filter-amount-max').value) || Infinity; filteredDeals = allDeals.filter(d => { const customer = customerTable.records.find(c => c.取引先ID === d.取引先ID); const matchesCustomer = !customerFilter || (customer?.取引先名 || '').toLowerCase().includes(customerFilter); const matchesSales = !salesFilter || d.営業担当者ID === salesFilter; const matchesStage = !stageFilter || d.ステージ === stageFilter; const matchesAmount = (d.商談金額 || 0) >= minAmount && (d.商談金額 || 0) <= maxAmount; return matchesCustomer && matchesSales && matchesStage && matchesAmount; }); renderDealList(); } function renderDealList() { const tbody = container.querySelector('#deal-tbody'); if (filteredDeals.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '該当する商談がありません'; return; } const rows = filteredDeals.map(d => { const customer = customerTable.records.find(c => c.取引先ID === d.取引先ID); return '' + d.商談名 + '' + (customer?.取引先名 || '-') + '' + formatNumber(d.商談金額) + '' + d.ステージ + '' + formatDate(d.成約予定日) + ''; }); tbody.innerHTML = rows.join(''); tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(tr => { tr.addEventListener('click', () => selectDeal(tr.dataset.id)); }); } function selectDeal(dealId) { currentDeal = allDeals.find(d => d.商談ID === dealId); if (!currentDeal) return; const panel = container.querySelector('#detail-panel'); const customer = customerTable.records.find(c => c.取引先ID === currentDeal.取引先ID); const sales = salesTable.records.find(s => s.営業担当者ID === currentDeal.営業担当者ID); let html = '
商談名' + (currentDeal.商談名 || '-') + '
'; html += '

'; html += '

'; if (currentDeal.説明) html += '
説明' + (currentDeal.説明 || '') + '
'; panel.innerHTML = html; renderInvoices(); renderInvoiceDetails(); updateButtonStates(); } function renderInvoices() { const tbody = container.querySelector('#invoice-tbody'); if (!currentDeal) { tbody.innerHTML = '商談を選択してください'; return; } const relatedInvoices = allInvoices.filter(i => i.商談ID === currentDeal.商談ID); if (relatedInvoices.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '関連する請求書がありません'; return; } const rows = relatedInvoices.map(i => { const paidAmount = i.入金金額 || 0; const status = i.請求ステータス || '-'; const paidStatus = paidAmount > 0 ? '入金済' : '入金待ち'; return '' + (i.請求書番号 || '-') + '' + formatDate(i.請求日) + '' + formatDate(i.支払期限日) + '' + formatNumber(i.請求金額) + '' + status + '' + paidStatus + ''; }); tbody.innerHTML = rows.join(''); } function renderInvoiceDetails() { const tbody = container.querySelector('#invoice-detail-tbody'); if (!currentDeal) { tbody.innerHTML = '商談を選択してください'; return; } const relatedDetails = allDetails.filter(d => { const invoice = allInvoices.find(i => i.請求書ID === d.請求書ID); return invoice && invoice.商談ID === currentDeal.商談ID; }); if (relatedDetails.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '請求明細がありません'; return; } const rows = relatedDetails.map(d => { return '' + d.明細行番号 + '' + d.商品名 + '' + (d.数量 || '-') + '' + formatNumber(d.単価) + '' + formatNumber(d.金額) + '' + (d.税率 || '0') + '%' + formatNumber(d.税額) + '' + formatNumber(d.税込金額) + ''; }); tbody.innerHTML = rows.join(''); } function updateButtonStates() { const btnGenerate = container.querySelector('#btn-generate-invoice'); const btnEdit = container.querySelector('#btn-edit-invoice'); const btnReissue = container.querySelector('#btn-reissue-invoice'); if (!currentDeal) { btnGenerate.disabled = true; btnEdit.disabled = true; btnReissue.disabled = true; return; } const relatedInvoices = allInvoices.filter(i => i.商談ID === currentDeal.商談ID); const hasInvoice = relatedInvoices.length > 0; btnGenerate.disabled = currentDeal.ステージ !== '成約' || hasInvoice; btnEdit.disabled = !hasInvoice; btnReissue.disabled = !hasInvoice; } function closeModal(modalId) { const modal = container.querySelector(modalId); if (modal) modal.classList.remove('open'); } function openModal(modalId) { const modal = container.querySelector(modalId); if (modal) modal.classList.add('open'); } container.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => { tab.addEventListener('click', () => { const targetTab = tab.dataset.tab; container.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active')); container.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tc => tc.classList.remove('active')); tab.classList.add('active'); container.querySelector('#' + targetTab + '-tab').classList.add('active'); }); }); container.querySelector('#filter-customer').addEventListener('input', applyFilters); container.querySelector('#filter-sales').addEventListener('change', applyFilters); container.querySelector('#filter-stage').addEventListener('change', applyFilters); container.querySelector('#filter-amount-min').addEventListener('input', applyFilters); container.querySelector('#filter-amount-max').addEventListener('input', applyFilters); container.querySelector('#btn-generate-invoice').addEventListener('click', () => openModal('#modal-generate')); container.querySelector('#btn-edit-invoice').addEventListener('click', () => container.querySelector('#edit-form').classList.add('visible')); container.querySelector('#btn-reissue-invoice').addEventListener('click', () => openModal('#modal-reissue')); container.querySelector('#modal-close-generate').addEventListener('click', () => closeModal('#modal-generate')); container.querySelector('#modal-close-reissue').addEventListener('click', () => closeModal('#modal-reissue')); container.querySelector('#btn-cancel-generate').addEventListener('click', () => closeModal('#modal-generate')); container.querySelector('#btn-cancel-reissue').addEventListener('click', () => closeModal('#modal-reissue')); container.querySelector('#btn-cancel-edit').addEventListener('click', () => container.querySelector('#edit-form').classList.remove('visible')); container.querySelector('#btn-confirm-generate').addEventListener('click', () => { alert('請求書を生成しました'); closeModal('#modal-generate'); renderInvoices(); }); container.querySelector('#btn-confirm-reissue').addEventListener('click', () => { alert('請求書を再発行しました'); closeModal('#modal-reissue'); }); container.querySelector('#btn-apply-edit').addEventListener('click', () => { alert('修正内容を反映しました'); container.querySelector('#edit-form').classList.remove('visible'); renderInvoiceDetails(); }); container.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(overlay => { overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) closeModal('#' + overlay.id); }); }); (async () => { await loadData(); initializeFilters(); applyFilters(); })(); }

営業活動.活動内容: 株式会社テックソリューション本社を訪問。営業部長・鈴木課長と面談。同社の事業内容、現在のシステム構成、課題について初期ヒアリング実施。
既存システムの拡張提案。新機能3点と導入スケジュール案を提示。顧客の課題に対する解決策を説明。
システム導入費用について、初期提示の1,800万円から1,500万円への値下げ要望を受け、保守費用の年間契約化で対応案を提示。次回までに経営層承認を取得予定。
契約内容最終確認、契約書署名予定日を2025年1月22日に決定
成約後の納品前フォローアップ。システム導入スケジュール確認、ユーザー教育の日程調整、本番環境への移行準備状況を確認。顧客側の準備体制に問題なし。
既存システムの機能追加と保守契約の拡大について提案。顧客より前向きな反応を得た。
前回失注理由の確認と現在のニーズ再調査。予算確保の見通しについてヒアリング。
定期接触。納入後の製品稼働状況確認、現在の満足度は高い。追加導入の可能性あり。
東京ビジネスエキスポ2024にて初回接触。同社はSaaS型経営管理システムの導入を検討中。製品カタログ・価格表を配布し、デモ動画URLをメール送付予定。
3ヶ月ぶりの訪問。前回提案から返答なし。決裁権者不在のため担当者と進捗確認。予算確保の時期を確認し、次回会議日程を調整。
